tors There are various other factors which can facilitate the interpretation of overpressures. The presence of cavings show that the shale is 'exploding' into the hole as the mud weight is insufficient to hold the formation back. Overpull during trips and connections show that the formation is flowing and squeezing around the drill pipe. Mud resistivity values can show if more pore fluids are present in the borehole
